change_summary: Compute experiment-only canonical state vectors from existing replayable OHLCV context and sweep a cap-aware top-up for non-ETF/non-Commodity core signals where leadership_vector=strong and risk_heat_vector=cool.

mid_weak.state_note: rotation-heavy bull where strategy makes money but lags indexes

old_thin.state_note: mixed-to-weak older tape with lower win rate

field_check.note: This risk-allocation experiment does not depend on these fields.

gate_questions.1_alpha_hypothesis: risk/capital allocation: strong leadership plus cool risk canonical state may mark safer top-up candidates among existing entries.
gate_questions.2_history_check: No prior trial used canonical_state_vectors as the sizing variable. Recent neighboring daily price-path, risk-on breakout, and core-misfit no-entry trials were rejected for window/sample/concentration failures.
gate_questions.3_single_causal_variable: post-sizing multiplier for canonical strong leadership + cool risk state
gate_questions.4_acceptance_standard: docs/backtesting.md three fixed windows; require positive aggregate EV/PnL, no EV-regressed window, drawdown/survival/trade-count/sample/concentration guards.

hypothesis: A compressed entry-day canonical state vector may identify already-qualified core signals where leadership is strong while portfolio/theme/regime risk heat is still cool. Those signals may deserve a small cap-aware risk top-up without changing entry, exit, ranking, universe, news, or LLM logic.
known_risks: Moderate multiple-testing risk because the clue came from a fresh read-only attribution surface.
The vector is production-computable but not yet promoted as a strategy input.
If accepted, production parity requires shared implementation before orders change.

market_regime_summary.mid_weak: rotation-heavy bull where strategy makes money but lags indexes
market_regime_summary.old_thin: mixed-to-weak older tape with lower win rate

next_retry_requires: Do not retry adjacent canonical leadership/risk scalar values on the same frozen windows without new forward rows or a distinct vector state.
Prefer promoting only if a shared parity-tested policy passes the same three-window protocol.
notes: No JavaScript used. This is alpha_search, not measurement repair.

production_impact.promotion_required_if_accepted: Move canonical vector state exposure and top-up into shared daily context/risk/portfolio modules with parity tests, then rerun the same three-window protocol before production use.

rejection_reason: Best variant failed Gate 4 because at least one fixed window regressed in expected_value_score.
why_not_other_changes: Skipped LLM soft-ranking because replay-safe attribution remains sparse. Skipped SEC/event/state-surface/broad-market/ETF nearby scalars due recent rejected or high-multiple-testing lanes. This tests a new compressed production-computable context field instead of another local threshold sweep.
